name: ycbcr2rgb
expr: r8 = ycbcr2rgb(Y8); r16 = ycbcr2rgb(Y16); rd = ycbcr2rgb(Yd);
comment: MATLAB ycbcr2rgb — YCbCr->RGB (BT.601, full-precision inverse = inv of the exact forward matrix), class-preserving across uint8 / uint16 / double. uint8/uint16 in -> same-class out (saturated to [0,255]/[0,65535]); double in -> double RGB in [0,1] (clipped). Pins R/G/B at two pixels for uint8 + uint16 + double. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-9 — was 1e-6 before the full-precision inverse fix). Octave ships it in image pkg only.
